ideas.pitch: An AI-powered tool that ingests chat exports from WhatsApp and Slack, mapping out emotional arcs and flagging sarcasm, passive-aggressiveness, and escalation points in real time.
ideas.title: ChatArc: Multi-Turn Conversation Tone & Escalation Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits all requirements of PS-01 with a concrete emotional-arc visualization dashboard, satisfying the core judging criteria for affective computing sentiment tracking.

ideas.pitch: A web utility that accepts raw audio recordings from support calls or meetings, extracting pitch, jitter, shimmer, and vocal inflection to predict hidden emotional states and stress levels.
ideas.problem_statement: PS-02 — Voice as a Mood Signal
ideas.title: VoicePulse: Voice-First Mood and Stress Signal Analyzer
ideas.track: PS-02 — Voice as a Mood Signal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles speech processing and affective computing—areas highlighted in the hackathon description—by transforming raw audio signals into interpretable psychological metrics.

ideas.pitch: A specialized NLP browser extension and dashboard that scans Slack channels for hidden friction, passive-aggressive remarks, and sarcasm among remote software teams.
ideas.title: SarcasmRadar: Detecting Passive-Aggressive Tones in Developer Chatlogs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem judges and developers feel themselves daily in remote collaboration tools, coupling high technical difficulty in irony detection with immediate practical utility.

ideas.pitch: A combined sentiment tracking pipeline that correlates textual transcripts with raw vocal prosody signals to resolve ambiguities like sarcasm where words and voice tones conflict.
ideas.problem_statement: PS-02 — Voice as a Mood Signal
ideas.title: EmoteSync: Multimodal Audio-Text Sentiment Synchronizer
ideas.track: PS-02 — Voice as a Mood Signal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines natural language processing and speech processing into a robust multimodal engine, showcasing advanced machine learning depth expected at a neural sentiment hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise-ready customer support dashboard that monitors incoming multi-turn support chats, scoring frustration levels and automatically triggering alerts before customer churn occurs.
ideas.title: EscalationGuard: Customer Support Sentiment and Tension Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear measurable economic impact by preventing customer support escalation, appealing directly to evaluators looking for practical AI business applications.
